def process(load_categories) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_categories.copy()
    df.columns = ['rank', 'category', 'reports', 'percentage']
    
    df = df[df['rank'] != 'Rank'].copy()
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['category'].notna()].copy()
    df = df[~df['category'].str.contains('Source:', na=False)].copy()
    
    df['reports'] = df['reports'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    return df
